name: Terminals
summary: Shells in this project's folder, arranged in tabs and tiles, running whether or not you are looking at them.
description: A terminal here is a shell in the project's folder, started the way this machine starts one — your login shell, so the tools you installed are on the path. Terminals are arranged in tabs, and a tab holds as many tiles as it is split into: drag a divider to change how the space is shared, and close a tile to give its space back to its neighbour. What runs is held by Sync rather than by the screen showing it, so leaving this section, hiding a tile behind another tab or resizing the window changes nothing about the build that is running — come back and it is where it got to. Closing the project is what ends them. This package runs commands in the project's folder as you, which is what a terminal is; nothing it does is narrower than that.
